import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps); lT=np.log(T)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]/eps+p[4]*T/eps+p[5]*T**2/eps
            +p[6]*L+p[7]*L*T**2+p[8]*L**2+p[9]*eps*L*lT*T**2)
